annotations.title: Make a clean copy without personal values

description: WORK on the rest: make a clean copy of a file with every sensitive value replaced by a typed token ([CARD], [ID], [IBAN], [PHONE], [EMAIL]); in CSV/TSV and Excel a column whose header names personal data (name, address, account number…) is replaced whole with one stable token per value ([NAME-1], [NAME-2] … — the same person keeps the same token), so rows and columns still line up and still group by person. Columns of amounts stay whole. Same detectors as the scan. The copy keeps the file's type: in Excel (.xlsx) the same column rule applies per sheet and the copy stays a workbook with its formatting; a Word document (.docx) or a deck (.pptx) stays one, with its tables, headings and slides, and its pictures blanked. The original is untouched; the copy is written next to it as <name>.clean.<ext> (a PDF with a text layer, or a document with charts or embedded files → .clean.txt, and the answer says why). A SCANNED PDF (no text layer) stays a PDF: every page is read by OCR on this computer, each value the detectors find and each of the user's terms (nodata_scan_terms) is painted black on the page image, and the copy is a new PDF of page images only, checked by reading it again with OCR. Never black out a PDF with a script of your own: this is the copy that carries the proof. The answer holds counts, kinds, the path and the proof, never the document's text: work from the clean copy at that path. ON SCREEN: someone may be sitting next to the user. Answer with totals, counts and summaries by default; ask before printing rows or individual values, even from the clean copy (a value the detectors did not recognise is still in it).

near_miss.description: Scanned PDF only: also paint a word one letter off one of the user's terms, or behind a Hebrew prefix. Off by default: it also paints ordinary words one letter away.

path.description: The file to redact (csv, tsv, txt, md, json, log, docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf).

return_text.description: Ignored: the text is never returned. Read the clean copy at the path in the answer.
